portfolio_use: Cross-country operator capacity/congestion evidence collection, NOT a Netherlands physical connection screen

original_csvs.name: TenneT feeding-area congestion indicators
original_csvs.original_labels_interpretation: 0/1/3 are unparsed source code values here; no red/orange or feasible classification is asserted

source_defined_field_labels.wachtrij: Requested capacity waiting-list data, not awarded grid MW
source_defined_field_labels.aanwezige_transportcapaciteit: Network design/installed capacity context, not available project headroom
source_defined_field_labels.benodigde_transportcapaciteit: Contractual peak requirements, not a project load request

known_limitations: Original web map is an indicative snapshot; timestamps and counts vary on source refresh.
Feeding areas and congestion rows are not deduplicated individual connections.
Explicit reuse terms for derived raw CSV exports have not been verified; publish metadata and aggregate counts only.
Original source labels 0/1/3 have not been confidently mapped to geographic congestion severity.
Waiting-list MW are unfulfilled requested transport capacity, not grid MW available to new applicants.
Neither map colour nor nominal capacity guarantees data-centre connection feasibility.
Do not compare Netherlands feeding-area values directly to Fingrid Grid Scope station MW.
